authority_basis: Explicit human operator routing preference. On 2026-09-20 the human explicitly re-authorized Anthropic/Claude for Garden review; NVIDIA/Nemotron and Mistral/Mistral AI remain re-authorized from 2026-09-19. This policy does not assert misconduct, poisoning, or wrongdoing as established fact.

superseded_exclusions.basis: Explicit human directive re-authorized Nemotron for future low-cost Garden review.
Explicit human directive re-authorized Mistral for future low-cost Garden review.
Explicit human directive re-authorized Anthropic/Claude for future Garden review.

prohibited_for_garden_work: direct API or hosted-service calls to currently excluded organizations
indirect routing through aggregators or fallbacks to currently excluded provider endpoints
use of models published or controlled by a currently excluded organization, including third-party-hosted routes
assignment of a currently excluded organization as reviewer, challenger, adjudicator, research agent, or synthesis agent
automatic or manual fallback to a currently excluded organization
allowed_non_operational_uses: preserving historical repository records and prior-art citations
mentioning an excluded organization when necessary for audit, provenance, incident analysis, or policy explanation
using independently sourced public evidence about an excluded organization without contacting or routing Garden work to it

change_control.latest_human_override: 2026-09-20: Anthropic/Claude re-authorized for Garden review; NVIDIA/Nemotron and Mistral remain re-authorized.

architecture_effect: No Garden semantic owner, authority source, truth source, or top-level engine is created. This is an operator/vendor routing constraint.
